title: Work Satisfaction and Everyday Work
summary: Workplace life, satisfaction, complaints, causes, and consequences.
whyItMatters: Work satisfaction depends on tasks, conditions, relationships, autonomy, recognition, and development, so useful discussion must connect experiences to causes and possible improvements.

mentalModel.title: Separate symptom, cause, and response
mentalModel.content: Describe what is happening, why it may happen, and what practical change could help.

mentalModel.title: Balance positive and negative factors
mentalModel.content: Evaluate the whole work situation rather than one isolated event.

ruleBlocks.title: Name satisfaction factors
ruleBlocks.content: Use Arbeitsklima, Gehalt, Arbeitszeit, Verantwortung, Anerkennung, Sicherheit, and Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe a complaint concretely
ruleBlocks.content: State the situation, frequency, impact, and desired change.

ruleBlocks.title: Distinguish cause from consequence
ruleBlocks.content: Use because-reason and therefore-result language accurately.

ruleBlocks.title: Propose a realistic improvement
ruleBlocks.content: Connect the action to responsibility, timing, and expected effect.

sentenceStructure: Use specific observations instead of labels.
Mark whether a cause is known or assumed.
Connect proposals to the stated problem.
Keep criticism focused on behavior and process.

comparisons.summary: Work routines and change processes require precise time relationships.
Survey data supports broader claims about workplace satisfaction.

examples.de: Mit meinen Aufgaben bin ich zufrieden, weil ich selbstständig arbeiten kann.
examples.en: I am satisfied with my tasks because I can work independently.

examples.de: Seit zwei Monaten müssen wir regelmäßig Überstunden machen.
examples.en: For two months we have regularly had to work overtime.

examples.de: Ich möchte ansprechen, dass sich die Prioritäten häufig kurzfristig ändern.
examples.en: I would like to address the fact that priorities often change at short notice.

examples.de: Die unklare Planung führt dazu, dass Termine schwer einzuhalten sind.
examples.en: The unclear planning makes deadlines difficult to meet.

examples.de: Eine wöchentliche Abstimmung könnte die Zusammenarbeit verbessern.
examples.en: A weekly coordination meeting could improve cooperation.

commonMistakes.correct: Describe the specific decision or communication problem.
Propose or ask for a feasible next step.

tips: Separate one-off events from recurring patterns.
